A Guy With A Scarf research/Automated match video/Premium edition/BEPRO (Bepro Company Co., Ltd. / Bepro Europe GmbH)

Club pays for a coaching tool

BEPRO (Bepro Company Co., Ltd. / Bepro Europe GmbH)Premium

Seoul, South Korea, with European entity in Hamburg and group entities in London · founded 2015 · active · bepro.ai · last verified 2026-09-19

Club pays for a coaching toolPortable unitDeployed in ItalyEvidence B€500 to €2,000 to start

A Korean-founded analysis company that sells a fixed or portable dual-lens 4K panoramic camera bundled with a cloud analysis suite, human-verified event data and optional video-based tracking data, aimed at academies and semi-professional clubs.

For Academies, semi-professional first teams and federations that already employ an analyst and want FIFA-qualified panoramic footage plus tagged event data delivered back within a day, with the option to add tracking-derived physical metrics without GPS vests. Fan streaming is a side benefit.

BEPRO exists because a Seoul team of analysts worked out in 2015 that the expensive part of football data was the human tagging, and that if you controlled the camera you could industrialise the tagging and sell it to clubs the big data houses ignored bepro-12, bepro-20. It matters now because the 2025 Cerberus OS3 release with RTMP live coding into Sportscode, the Camera Station that accepts any IP camera, and published dollar pricing for the portable kit mark a shift from bespoke fixed installs toward a self-serve product for smaller clubs bepro-10, bepro-09, bepro-02. It tells you that the analysis-first vendors are moving down market into the same academies that Veo and Pixellot serve from the streaming side, and that data delivered with the video, ahead of the camera itself, is where they intend to win.

Price band USD 2,000 one-off for the Cerberus portable camera plus USD 1,000 per year (or USD 83.33 per month) for BEPRO Space and Editor software, VAT excluded; fixed camera and event data services on quotation bepro-02

Italy BEPRO lists Italy among its office countries, has been the video analysis partner of the Divisione Calcio a 5 for Serie A futsal with a renewal announced in October 2024, and installed fixed cameras at Bologna FC's youth training grounds in December 2020 under an Italian business director bepro-08, bepro-15, bepro-16.

The verdict

Look if You have an analyst or a coach who will use event data and clips every week, you want the tagging done for you, and you are comfortable with a USD-priced contract from a company headquartered in Seoul with a Hamburg legal entity for European terms. Look also if you need to feed live panoramic video into Sportscode or Nacsport on the bench, which the Cerberus does over RTMP.

Skip if Your priority is a fan-facing live stream with sponsor overlays and a paywall, because BEPRO offers no OTT layer of its own and its live path is aimed at analysts. Skip also if you need transparent published pricing for the fixed system or the data services, or if you want the recording available within minutes of the final whistle, since the portable camera uploads 30 to 60 minutes after the match on the vendor's own figures.

Watch-outs

  • The terms of use grant BEPRO a non-exclusive, unlimited, gratuitous, non-revocable, transferable and worldwide right to use submitted content for commercial and non-commercial purposes, which covers your match footage bepro-11.
  • Prices on the site are shown in USD with VAT excluded and no currency selector, so a European club should confirm the EUR invoice amount and the entity that bills it bepro-02, bepro-04.
  • The software bundle sold with the camera is USD 1,000 per year, while the standalone BEPRO Space and Editor page lists USD 5,000 per year or USD 500 per month, and the site does not explain which tier a club receives bepro-02, bepro-04.
  • Upload of a two-hour match completes within one hour in about 72% of the 184 recordings BEPRO cites, which means roughly one match in four takes longer bepro-02.
  • The Hamburg entity Bepro Europe GmbH has €25,000 share capital, sits at a WeWork address and its most recent filed accounts are for 2021, so European counterparty substance is thin bepro-17.
  • No Korean parent financials, headcount or post-2020 funding rounds are public, and the last disclosed raise was €8.8 million in June 2020 bepro-12, bepro-18.
  • Resolution, weight, lens and storage specifications for the Cerberus are absent from the product page, which describes battery life and upload behaviour only bepro-02.

Products

  • Cerberus (BEPRO Portable Camera) (camera). Dual-lens 4K panoramic AI camera with swappable 4.5-hour batteries, on-device processing, WiFi control and RTMP output for live coding. bepro-02
  • BEPRO Fixed Camera and Camera Station (camera). Permanently installed panoramic camera with scheduled recording, plus a plug-and-play processing station that accepts any IP camera. bepro-05
  • BEPRO Quadpod (add-on). 7.6-metre aluminium four-legged stand weighing 6.5 kg with stabilisers and a wheeled backpack bag. bepro-03
  • BEPRO Space (platform). Cloud platform on web, mobile and tablet for schedules, video, data reports, library and team messaging. bepro-04
  • BEPRO Editor (app). Desktop editor with collaborative editing, live coding, custom view recording, tags and XML import. bepro-07
  • Standard, Advanced and Bespoke Data, Data API (add-on). Human-verified event data to FIFA definitions, video-tracking metrics without GPS, custom reports and API access. bepro-21

Profile against the 24 criteria

Use-case fit
BEPRO is an analysis product first, with FIFA-qualified 4K panoramic recording feeding event tagging, interactive reports, positional data and a collaborative editor, and its named users run from Larne FC and the Accrington Stanley academy to the Spain national team at Euro 2024 and the K League technical study group bepro-01, bepro-20, bepro-14. Academies with a staff analyst are the sweet spot. A grassroots club with no analyst will pay for data it will struggle to use.
Capture quality
The company describes FIFA-qualified 4K panoramic capture from two internal cameras stitched into one wide feed, with the OS3 update adding steadier zoom scale and better framing from off-centre positions bepro-01, bepro-10. The soccerscene profile notes the system scored well above industry standard in most FIFA certification assessments with no score below above industry standard bepro-20. The Cerberus page publishes no sensor, lens, frame rate or bitrate figures, so quality claims rest on the FIFA qualification and sample footage bepro-02.
Automation accuracy
Recording is fully automatic with no operator, and the AI View was upgraded in June 2025 to reduce excessive zooming, track the ball more precisely and crop out areas beyond the pitch bepro-10. Event data is collected to FIFA definitions with every data point linked to video for verification, and advanced data adds xG, xT, line-breaking passes and packing from video tracking without GPS bepro-21, bepro-06. BEPRO publishes no accuracy percentages for the automatic framing, and the human tagging layer is what carries data accuracy.
Multi-angle and stitching
The Cerberus stitches its two internal cameras on the device, and the BEPRO Camera Station released in July 2025 ingests any IP camera into the same system for fixed installs, which lets a club combine BEPRO and third-party cameras under one recording pipeline bepro-10, bepro-09, bepro-05. Multi-angle production for broadcast is not offered. The panoramic feed plus a tactical view and a proprietary 3D player are the viewing modes bepro-01.
Latency and live readiness
Cerberus OS3 added RTMP output so analysts can live code in Sportscode, SBG or Nacsport from a laptop connected to the camera, and the Editor supports live coding over a stadium network or a direct cable bepro-10, bepro-07. Real-time review on the pitch, including at half-time, is a stated feature of the fixed system bepro-05. There is no fan streaming product, no published latency figure and no built-in RTMP push to YouTube described on the product pages.
Reliability and resilience
The camera is weather resistant for rain and snow, runs 4.5 hours or more per swappable battery with 9 hours or more on a spare, and OS3 fixed quality degradation from heat during long recordings bepro-02, bepro-10. Upload completed within an hour for about 72% of 184 two-hour recordings in the vendor's own data, which is honest and also means a quarter of matches arrive later bepro-02. Independent reliability reports are absent; the App Store rating of 4.7 rests on 10 reviews bepro-19.
Portability and install
The portable kit is the Cerberus on the 7.6-metre four-legged BEPRO Quadpod, which weighs 6.5 kg against 12 kg for a conventional 7.7-metre tripod and ships in a wheeled carrier that doubles as a backpack, with stabilisers included bepro-03. The fixed camera is permanently installed and scheduled for the season, with the Camera Station making install a matter of power and network bepro-05. Setup time for the portable kit is not stated.
Connectivity and bandwidth
The camera creates its own WiFi network for control from the mobile app or Editor, processes video during recording and uploads afterwards, with 30 to 60 minutes typical for a two-hour match bepro-02. No LTE modem, no Ethernet port and no minimum upload speed are listed for the portable camera. The fixed system needs power and network at the venue bepro-05.
Workflow and UX
BEPRO Space runs on web, mobile and tablet with schedule filters, full match and clip video, team and player data, a shared library with recovery of deleted items, and an in-app messenger for sending clips to players, while BEPRO Editor adds Google Docs style simultaneous editing, presentation files, secondary tags with pivot tables and XML import from Sportscode bepro-04, bepro-07, bepro-09. The mobile app was fully redesigned in September 2025 bepro-09. This is an analyst's toolset with a lot of surface area, a long way from a two-button club app.
Analysis layer
Three data tiers exist: standard event data to FIFA definitions with heatmaps and interactive reports, advanced data using video tracking for xG, xT, xA, packing, runs in behind and physical metrics for both teams without GPS, and bespoke reports, plus a Data API and raw tracking files for clubs that want to process data themselves bepro-21, bepro-06, bepro-01. Analysis covers football, futsal, basketball and handball bepro-21. The article by the vendor's Australian profile puts output at about three million data points per 90 minutes bepro-20.
Integrations
RTMP into Sportscode, SBG and Nacsport, XML import from Sportscode into the Editor, IP camera ingest through the Camera Station and a Data API cover the main integration paths bepro-10, bepro-07, bepro-09, bepro-01. There is no listed integration with club management, ticketing or OTT platforms. Video export from the Editor allows clips and custom views to be downloaded or shared bepro-07.
Distribution and OTT
BEPRO has no fan-facing platform, paywall or sponsor overlay product; distribution is internal to the club through BEPRO Space and the messenger bepro-04. A club wanting to stream to supporters would need to take the RTMP feed into its own encoder or platform, which the product pages do not describe bepro-10. Not assessable further from public sources.
Data access and ownership
Users retain ownership of uploaded content and can download team and player data, clips, custom views and raw tracking files bepro-11, bepro-04, bepro-06. The same terms give BEPRO a non-exclusive, unlimited, non-revocable, transferable worldwide licence to use submitted content commercially, and retention periods and hosting location are not specified beyond a centralised cloud bepro-11. Clubs with sensitive academy footage should negotiate this clause.
Privacy and compliance
German law and Hamburg jurisdiction apply to commercial clients through Bepro Europe GmbH, and the terms note that user activity may be monitored within legal limits with IP data collected bepro-11. No consent workflow for filmed minors, no blurring feature and no data processing agreement template are published. Not assessable beyond the terms from public sources.
Security
Data is stored in a centralised cloud with no stated region, and no certification, penetration test or access control documentation is public bepro-11. Not assessable from public sources.
Pricing and TCO
The Cerberus portable camera is USD 2,000 one-off with BEPRO Space and Editor at USD 83.33 per month or USD 1,000 per year, the Quadpod is USD 500, and the standalone Space plus Editor subscription is USD 500 per month or USD 5,000 per year (USD 416.67 per month), all VAT excluded bepro-02, bepro-03, bepro-04. Fixed cameras, the Camera Station, standard and advanced data and bespoke reports are all on quotation bepro-05, bepro-21, bepro-06. A first-year portable setup is therefore about USD 3,500 before tax and before any data service, with the data service the real cost driver for most clubs.
Support and service
The site offers demos, a free trial and contact sales routes, and the company says it has offices in the UK, USA, Germany, Spain, Italy, South Korea, Japan and Vietnam with a London address published bepro-08, bepro-01. No SLA, support hours or response commitments are public. Not assessable beyond this from public sources.
Company health and roadmap
BEPRO raised €7.9 million in 2018 and €8.8 million in June 2020 from Altos Ventures, SoftBank Ventures, Saehan Ventures, Springcamp and Mirae Asset Ventures, and no later round is public bepro-12. The Korean parent Bepro Company Co., Ltd. discloses no revenue or headcount on Korean business portals, and the Hamburg entity's last filed accounts cover 2021 bepro-18, bepro-17. Product cadence in 2025 and 2026 is steady, with six shipped updates listed from June 2025 to May 2026, which is the best public health signal available bepro-09.
Evidence and references
Named references include the Spain national team at Euro 2024, the K League technical study group, the KFA Golden Pass youth programme, Regionalliga Nordost, the Divisione Calcio a 5, Bologna FC's youth sector, Larne FC and the Accrington Stanley academy, and the vendor claims more than 2,400 teams across 50 nations and more than 500,000 matches analysed bepro-20, bepro-14, bepro-13, bepro-15, bepro-16, bepro-01. FIFA qualification of the camera is the one third-party technical validation bepro-01, bepro-20.
Coach and analyst satisfaction
Public sentiment is thin: the BEPRO Sports app holds 4.7 from 10 ratings with praise for real-time stats and a request for more frequent updates, and the Korean employer review site rates the company 3.1 out of 5 bepro-19, bepro-18. Federation quotes from the KFA and K League are positive about data quality and scientific youth development bepro-13, bepro-14. No independent club review of the Cerberus is public.
Edge versus cloud
The Cerberus processes video on the device during recording so that upload can start as soon as the match ends, and it exposes RTMP locally for live coding without cloud dependency bepro-02, bepro-10. Event tagging and advanced tracking happen in BEPRO's cloud and analyst operation, with a turnaround the site does not quantify. The fixed Camera Station is a plug-and-play on-site processing unit bepro-05.
Accessibility and languages
The mobile app supports English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean and Spanish, and the website runs in English with a Korean version bepro-19, bepro-01. Office presence in Italy and Spain suggests local-language sales support, though no Italian support line is published bepro-08.
Upgrade path
A club can start with the portable Cerberus and software, add standard then advanced data, move to a fixed install through the Camera Station with any IP camera, and take raw tracking or the Data API when it has its own data staff bepro-02, bepro-05, bepro-06. Camera firmware updates ship over the air, as OS3 did in June 2025 bepro-10. No trade-in terms are published.
Differentiators worth testing
Test the RTMP live coding path into your existing Sportscode or Nacsport licence on the bench, since that is BEPRO's clearest technical edge among portable cameras bepro-10. Time the upload on your own connection across three matches and compare against the 72% within-one-hour figure bepro-02. Order one match of advanced data and check the tracking-derived physical numbers against a GPS session before committing to a season bepro-06.

Company

Ownership and funding Bepro Company Co., Ltd. was founded in Seoul on 12 February 2015 with CEO Kang Hyun-wook, who is also managing director of Bepro Europe GmbH in Hamburg (HRB 148801, €25,000 share capital, formerly EPIKO CS GmbH) bepro-18, bepro-17. Disclosed venture funding totals €7.9 million in 2018 and €8.8 million in June 2020 from Altos Ventures, SoftBank Ventures, Saehan Ventures, Springcamp and Mirae Asset Ventures bepro-12. Group entities BEPRO GROUP LTD and BEPRO-UK LTD are listed at a London address bepro-08.

Financials Not public. Korean business portals show no revenue, profit or headcount for the parent, and the Hamburg entity's most recent filed annual accounts are for fiscal 2021 bepro-18, bepro-17.

Scale, company-stated More than 1,000 organisations per the homepage in September 2026 bepro-01; more than 2,400 teams across 50 nations per a November 2024 profile bepro-20; more than 500,000 matches analysed across 20 nations per the Divisione Calcio a 5 in October 2024 bepro-15; 184 two-hour recordings cited in the upload statistic bepro-02.
